# 2.3.0 acceptance coverage

The deterministic suite has 77 passing tests. Source declarations and synthetic
choices remain distinct from execution observations. The plan's identifiers
below describe validation scope, rather than universal submission requirements.

| Plan scenarios | Evidence and result |
| --- | --- |
| SRC-01, SRC-02 | GitHub public/private response fixtures pin the commit and reproduce ZIP bytes; local folder/ZIP inspection is exercised. Actual octocat/Hello-World transport smoke passed. A live plugin repository submission journey was not run. |
| SRC-03 | Multiple observed plugin roots require one native choice; 21-root pagination fits the 2–10 option harness contract. Wrapped subtree imports and repairs retain executable bits. |
| SRC-04 | Private metadata/authorized request behavior is controlled; no actual private repository was accessed. Unavailable retrieval returns an input error without inventing access. |
| DOC-01 | Index-discovered aliases and new official pages are selected and indexed without a rule-source edit. |
| DOC-02, DOC-07 | Current-primary constraints override an older export; exact source hashes/spans are required. Advisory text cannot be relabeled mandatory. Table subjects exclude incidental field mentions. |
| DOC-03 | HTML article parsing, HTTP 304 retention and unavailable retrieval are tested. Final live HTTP fetched 21 records with no gaps; the minimal Todo page yielded no invented requirement. |
| DOC-04, DOC-05, DOC-06 | General targets request no specialized conversion primary URLs. Each detected activity selects only its own specialized primary. Stock quotes, calendar events and README ambitions do not trigger them. |
| SYN-01, SYN-02, SYN-03 | Declared tools/skills generate source-referenced tasks, personas, ordinary boundaries and prompts. An actual agent refined the review fixture and a separate agent found its task/review mismatch. Inference does not establish host execution. |
| QA-01, QA-02 | One simulated accept generates cases and bundle records. Multi-select task/boundary adjustments, audience/host choices and corrections update persisted state. |
| QA-03 | Stale/replayed choices are refused. A refined question survives a source re-read and accepts the current response. |
| QA-04 | Widget payload uses only the provider's advertised fields. Actual native rendering/selection was not exercised; no unsupported preselection is emitted. |
| REV-01 | Actual independent output is retained with current source/docs/request bindings. Its six findings include four official failures, one sourced guidance item and one engineering recommendation. |
| REV-02 | A real missing-reference error in a synthetic target is repaired through the prepared native-apply path, followed by source inspection and rechecking. Before hashes prevent stale replacements. |
| REV-03 | Unavailable review/host workflows retain unrun status. Runner fixtures execute a separate controlled process. Outstanding host-job receipts survive export/restore without becoming completed verdicts. |
| BND-01 | Unit and actual-agent export/restore continuations preserve exact source, docs, selections and raw review evidence. The final runtime restored the completed independent checkpoint and verified the raw hash. |
| BND-02 | Documentation changes invalidate affected review/findings while retaining bound host captures. Test-plan changes invalidate the old independent verdict. Source changes reset dependent execution/portal observations. |
| BND-03 | A real historical version-1 checkpoint restores its plan, pause state, history and execution binding; a missing draft is populated. No new creator confirmation/current offline-policy read is invented. |
| BND-04 | The inspected source archive is separate from the session's work bundle. Its ZIP bytes survive copying/relocation; generated private session evidence is not added to the source archive. |

Python compilation, skill validation, both TypeScript syntax checks and the
pinned connector-kit build passed. TypeScript sources/dependencies are preserved;
this release does not claim a new live protocol/installed-host test. Package
structure is checked again after the evidence and release notes are assembled.
